summary: Frontend Coding Agent applied the B3 fix for Gate 9 review finding on PR #77 (NFR-REL-001 Auto-Save Crash Durability). The idb production dependency was missing from frontend/package.json despite being imported by dbSchema.ts. Added 'idb': '^8.0.0' to the dependencies section. This was the only remaining blocking issue — all prior findings (B1, B2, M1, M2, M3) were already verified as resolved in Gate 9. Commit d216a3f pushed to branch feature/18-nfr-rel-001-frontend-tests.

blocking_fixed.fix: Added 'idb': '^8.0.0' to the dependencies section. Production code in dbSchema.ts imports from 'idb' — without this declaration, npm install would not install the package and the build would fail.
